name: N.A.W. World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Deathwish's own belt, taken from him by a debuting "Mr. Muscle" Jim Vickens the night his own ally Jade "The Blade" turned on him at ringside.

name: N.A.W. World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Changed hands twice inside eight days in the spring of 1998, landing on the Midnight Strikers by way of a folding chair.

name: N.A.W. Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Jeff "The Machine" Keenan's belt until a chair shot from Bill Bob Woijicowski put it on Mad Goat instead.

name: N.A.W. Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The Bladeliners' own prize, successfully defended against the Widow Makers on Tuesday Night Tango.
notes: A separately billed tag title from the later Tuesday Night Tango era, distinct in this record from the earlier World Tag Team Championship; no document ties the two lineages together.

name: N.A.W. East Coast Championship
epitaph: "Human Torture Rack" Ian Walsh's own regional belt until Dennis Windham took it from him with a low blow and the Texas Death Drop.
